mat.text: In March of the Machine: The Aftermath, the storm elemental arrives when a blue rift tears open and a lightning-veined beast bursts out, forcing Nissa to fight it alone and without her magic or leylines. Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast, until Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.

The beast returns and ransacks the village, and Nissa leads it away with roots. Chandra arrives and fights it with fire, but her fireballs boil a baobab and make it grow colossal, forcing them into a pit.
Nissa then realizes the creature is a storm elemental from another plane, and channels Zhalfir's power into Chandra to heat it into steam and rain.
